task.name: pick_eraser_place_right_box
task.description: Use the left arm to grasp the eraser from the table and place it in the black box on the right.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the eraser on the table.
2. Grasp the eraser with the left arm.
3. Move the left arm to align with the black box on the right.
4. Release the gripper to place the eraser into the black box.
